implementation_steps: Reconcile all P0 R1 requirements to executed applicable acceptance/control/provider evidence.
Verify named accountable owners, actual terms/policies, staff coverage, support/escalation and pilot limits.
Produce a concrete deployment/pilot release record with remaining scoped limitations and the organization's launch decision reference.
Perform permitted canary/pilot actions only under the real operating context; record recovery/readiness evidence.
definition_of_done: R1 is never labeled ready from local simulator results alone.
Required policies, provider certification and staffed operations are evidenced; unresolved launch blockers remain visible.
Accountable launch authority and actual pilot/deployment outcomes are recorded distinctly from software build results.
verification: Complete R1 evidence/requirement audit, operational rehearsal and actual qualified deployment/pilot verification.

work_packages.title: Implement consented partner APIs and delegated account authority
implementation_steps: Implement registered clients, scoped grants/expiry/revocation, account delegation and partner quotas.
Expose documented customer-consented inquiry/payment operations with client/actor/customer evidence and callback controls.
Exercise revocation with in-flight operations and preserve financial lifecycle for already submitted instructions.
definition_of_done: Over-scoped/expired/revoked grants fail; staff authority cannot be obtained through partner tokens.
Delegation revocation blocks new actions but preserves historical actor evidence.
Production enablement requires R1 qualification and actual partner policy/contracts.
verification: AT-21 plus scoped client, account delegation, quota and version-transition cases.

work_packages.title: Implement branch, private banker and call center adapters
implementation_steps: Implement assisted-channel contracts preserving staff actor, represented customer, authorization and channel.
Expose approved onboarding/servicing/payment flows through common domain rules and per-channel restrictions.
Build fixtures and real channel integration only for confirmed operations; record channel certification.
definition_of_done: Assistance cannot bypass account/control restrictions or identity assurance.
Audit identifies actor/customer/channel and recorded authority across handoff.
Only confirmed/certified operations are enabled in each actual channel.
verification: AT-22 and assisted customer handoff, restrictions and staff-audience negative tests.

work_packages.title: Implement ATM integration and channel certification
implementation_steps: Define confirmed ATM/network operations, authorization/cash/debit boundaries and failure reversals in a channel supplement.
Implement simulator and chosen network adapter using common account restrictions and financial keys.
Prove timeout/reversal/reconciliation and channel authentication without assuming cash logistics or full card issuing are in scope.
definition_of_done: Unsupported ATM operations fail explicitly and cannot bypass enabled account/rail policy.
Duplicate authorization/execution/reversal evidence has bounded unique financial effects.
Actual network certification remains required before enablement.
verification: AT-22/28 plus ATM-specific lost response, duplicate, reversal and network certification cases.

work_packages.title: Implement additional payment rails with individual supplements
implementation_steps: Create separate contract/state/format/calendar/finality supplements for ACH, checks, debit, bill pay, wire, lockbox, SWIFT and P2P as selected.
Implement each required adapter plus simulator/fault fixtures and routing/limit enablement.
Certify inbound/outbound authority, settlement evidence, fees, cancellation/return/dispute and reconciliation for each actual enabled rail.
Keep SWIFT messaging distinct from settlement and debit scope distinct from an assumed issuing program.
definition_of_done: No rail becomes enabled through a generic placeholder or shared success response.
Each enabled direction has its own verified finality/recovery/financial mapping.
All source rail options remain allocated even when commercial selection delays a particular adapter.
verification: Per-rail AT-08/09/10/11/12/28 branches and certification evidence.

work_packages.title: Implement governed warehouse, mastered assets and big-data ingestion
implementation_steps: Implement versioned governed ingestion, canonical-link lineage and reproducible warehouse transforms.
Add selected analytical storage/processing adapters, purpose tags, quality watermarks and source-to-report control totals.
Exercise backfill, correction, schema upgrade and master-reference conflicts without rewriting financial history.
definition_of_done: Historical aggregates trace to source/schema/transform versions and authorized purpose.
Backfill/replay preserves economic deduplication and shows missing/stale sources.
Analytical principals cannot post or mutate Core balances.
verification: AT-13/23/25/28 lineage, backfill, purpose denial and schema compatibility cases.

work_packages.title: Implement audiences, insights and journey partner orchestration
implementation_steps: Build permissioned segmentation and advisory insights with versioned provenance and withdrawal handling.
Integrate selected journey partners using minimized consented signals and safe recommendation APIs.
Report campaign/journey outcomes with explicit denominators, watermarks and purpose restrictions.
definition_of_done: Marketing withdrawal prevents optional targeting/exports without destroying required evidence.
Partner recommendations cannot approve customers, alter entitlements or post money.
Outcome reports retain lineage and disclose missing/late data.
verification: AT-23/28 plus purpose-revocation, export restriction and advisory-boundary cases.

work_packages.title: Implement advanced routing and approval optimization
implementation_steps: Add versioned policy-driven route/approval strategies using measured provider health and permitted limits.
Implement safe fallback only when original instruction non-execution is proven; preserve same economic identity.
Shadow-evaluate strategies before bounded enablement and compare outcomes/fees/latency.
definition_of_done: Optimization cannot bypass required controls or duplicate a payment across providers.
Policy versions and route reasons are attributable and can be rolled forward/back compatibly.
Benefit is measured against a real baseline; unavailable production evidence stays pending.
verification: Cross-provider unknown-outcome, approval independence and shadow/rollback invariant cases.

work_packages.title: Implement liquidity forecasting and controlled finance automation
implementation_steps: Build reproducible forecast inputs/models with data quality, as-of uncertainty and versioned policy limits.
Implement independently approved automated finance actions through existing unique financial commands.
Simulate breaches/stale sources and compare forecast/operating outcomes against actual baselines.
definition_of_done: Missing/stale evidence cannot appear as confirmed funds or justify unsafe automated action.
A policy breach stops restricted actions and creates owned escalation.
Automated actions remain balanced, unique, approved and traceable.
verification: AT-24/25 plus forecast reproducibility, stale input and limit-breach automation cases.

work_packages.title: Measure product outcomes and optimize capacity/cost
implementation_steps: Publish validated KPI denominators/cohorts and compare actual onboarding/payment/support outcomes.
Profile measured application/database/broker/client bottlenecks and optimize only supported changes.
Evaluate service extraction, storage scale and cost with evidence; update ADRs, deployment models and recovery tests.
definition_of_done: Claimed improvements use measured data, documented exclusions and reproducible checks.
Financial, authorization, recovery and accessibility invariants still pass after optimization.
Changed physical boundaries retain domain ownership, contracts and operational evidence.
verification: Before/after load/outcome/cost report plus affected full financial/security/recovery regression.
